events.title: Social Games at Broadbeach
events.description: A casual, community-oriented social gathering at the library for adults to play board games and card games, encouraging interaction and conversation.

events.title: Artist Stories: Make Art Work
events.description: An intellectually stimulating talk where an artist shares their journey and insights into making a career in the arts, aimed at fostering creative community and inspiration.

events.title: This Moment: Highlights from the White Rabbit Collection of Chinese Contemporary Art
events.description: An extensive exhibition showcasing significant works from the renowned White Rabbit Collection, offering a deep dive into contemporary Chinese art and culture.

events.title: Aka Sorbie: Saltwater Heart
events.description: An exhibition by artist Aka Sorbie, exploring themes related to the ocean and cultural heritage, offering a unique artistic perspective.

events.title: Art Explorers
events.description: A free, hands-on art workshop program at HOTA Gallery, encouraging participants to explore creative techniques and materials. Registration is required.

events.title: This Moment Experience - The Exhibitionist Bar (Guided Tour & Lunch)
events.description: A guided tour of the "This Moment" exhibition, offering deeper insights into the artworks, followed by a social lunch experience at The Exhibitionist Bar.

events.title: Sunroom - Sustainable Still Life
events.description: A hands-on creative workshop focusing on sustainable art practices, where participants will learn to create still life pieces using environmentally conscious methods.

events.title: Dumpling Masterclass
events.description: A hands-on cooking workshop where participants learn the art of making dumplings, covering techniques from dough preparation to filling and folding.

events.title: Believe it or Not! research workshops
events.description: A series of research workshops exploring various topics, designed to stimulate intellectual curiosity and engage participants in critical thinking and academic inquiry.

events.title: NAIDOC Week
events.location: Southern Cross University Gold Coast Campus
events.description: A cultural event celebrating the history, culture, and achievements of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, typically featuring talks, performances, and community gatherings.

events.title: Trivia Tuesdays
events.location: Sports Bar, The Star Gold Coast
events.description: A weekly trivia night at The Star's Sports Bar, offering a fun and engaging opportunity to test knowledge across various subjects in a social setting.

events.title: Line Dancing on the Lawn
events.location: The Lawn, The Star Gold Coast
events.description: A social and active event where participants can learn and enjoy line dancing on the outdoor lawn, fostering community connection through movement.
